name: Employee, 75,000
workings: Contributions (employee shares, childless): pension 9.3% × 75,000 = 6,975.00; unemployment 1.3% = 975.00; health (7.3% + 1.45%) × 69,750 = 6,103.125; care 2.4% = 1,674.00

Special expenses: pension 6,975.00 (employee and employer shares within 30,826, less the employer's); health × 0.96 (sick pay) + care = 7,533.00, above 1,900, so the unemployment contribution isn't deductible
